physicalNotes: Radius 0.1579091 Jupiter radii from Fukui 2025 (2025RNAAS...9...73F), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025RNAAS...9...73F/abstract): 11,289.2 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Fukui et al. 2022 (2022PASJ...74L...1F), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022PASJ...74L...1F/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.06135386 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
